name: Hyperbolic functions: definitions and graphs
about: Part 3. The six definitions, cosh² − sinh² = 1, and the six graphs.

cards.back: sinh x / cosh x = (eˣ − e⁻ˣ)/(eˣ + e⁻ˣ)

cards.front: Sketch y = sinh x. Mark the origin.
cards.back: Domain all x, range all y. Odd, increasing, through (0, 0). Grows like eˣ/2 for large x.

cards.front: Sketch y = cosh x. Mark the lowest point.
cards.back: Domain all x, range [1, ∞). Even, minimum 1 at x = 0. Grows like eˣ/2 for large |x|.

cards.front: Sketch y = tanh x. Mark the asymptotes.
cards.back: Domain all x, range (−1, 1). Odd, increasing, asymptotes y = ±1.

cards.front: Sketch y = sech x. Mark the highest point and the asymptote.
cards.back: Domain all x, range (0, 1]. Even, maximum 1 at x = 0, asymptote y = 0.

cards.front: Sketch y = csch x. Mark the asymptotes.
cards.back: Domain x ≠ 0, range y ≠ 0. Odd, decreasing on each branch, asymptotes x = 0 and y = 0.

cards.front: Sketch y = coth x. Mark the asymptotes.
cards.back: Domain x ≠ 0, range |y| > 1. Odd, decreasing on each branch, asymptotes x = 0 and y = ±1.
